processed_data_format: Normalized expression CSV per cell-line/treatment arm (GSE244554_IOMM-Lee_cells_AZ628.CSV.gz, GSE244554_IOMM-Lee_cells_KD-SLC7A1.CSV.gz, GSE244554_SZ8511_cells_AZ628.CSV.gz, GSE244554_SZ8511_cells_KD-SLC7A1.CSV.gz)
needs_manual_review_reason: Adjacent-scope per docs/scope.md: live GEO record (verified directly via acc.cgi) confirms Series_overall_design describes SLC7A1 knockdown and AZ628 small-molecule drug-treatment RNA-seq performed in two established meningioma cell lines (IOMM-Lee, an immortalized grade 3 meningioma line already seen in this corpus's other adjacent records, and SZ8511), with no primary patient tumor tissue submitted to this accession; 24 total Series_sample_id entries (GSM7819031-GSM7819054) across the two cell lines and two experimental arms (SLC7A1 knockdown vs. AZ628 treatment), consistent with the 4 processed supplementary files (one per cell-line/arm combination). Series_pubmed_id (41184266) verified via PubMed esummary as Song et al., Cell Death Discovery 2025, matching the series title verbatim. Note the GEO record shows an unusually late Series_status ('Public on Sep 27 2025') relative to its 2023 submission date, i.e. a long embargo before release; this was verified as-is from the live record, not fabricated. Author list truncated to first 6 per this corpus's existing citation-formatting convention. who_edition/patient_count use the established 'Not applicable (cell line)' convention for non-patient-tissue model systems.
